select s.session_id, s.title, s.session_type, s.client_type, s.client_tools, s.client_tools_ver, s.source_job_id, s.project_id, s.user_id, s.status, s.total_tokens, s.prompt_tokens, s.completion_tokens, s.llm_call_count, s.context_length, s.message_count, s.create_by, s.create_time, s.update_by, s.update_time, s.remark, u.nick_name as user_name, (select count(1) from ai_chat_session_agent sa where sa.session_id = s.session_id) as agent_count,
(select sa2.agent_id from ai_chat_session_agent sa2 where sa2.session_id = s.session_id and sa2.role = 'supervisor' order by sa2.id asc limit 1) as supervisor_agent_id, (select ag.agent_name from ai_chat_session_agent sa3 left join ai_agent ag on ag.agent_id = sa3.agent_id where sa3.session_id = s.session_id and sa3.role = 'supervisor' order by sa3.id asc limit 1) as supervisor_agent_name,
(select group_concat(sk.kb_id order by sk.sort) from ai_chat_session_kb sk where sk.session_id = s.session_id) as kb_ids from ai_chat_session s left join sys_user u on s.user_id = u.user_id
mapper.select: select s.project_id from ai_chat_session s join ai_project p on p.project_id = s.project_id and p.del_flag = '0' and p.user_id = s.user_id where s.del_flag = '0' and s.session_id = #{sessionId} limit 1

select s.session_id from ai_chat_session s join ai_project p on p.project_id = s.project_id and p.del_flag = '0' and p.user_id = s.user_id where s.del_flag = '0' and s.project_id = #{projectId} order by s.create_time asc, s.session_id asc

select session_id, title, session_type, client_type, client_tools, client_tools_ver, source_job_id, project_id, user_id, status, total_tokens, prompt_tokens, completion_tokens, llm_call_count, context_length, message_count, create_by, create_time, update_by, update_time, remark from ai_chat_session where del_flag = '0' and session_id = #{sessionId} for update

mapper.update: update ai_chat_session set client_type = #{clientType}, client_tools = #{clientTools}, client_tools_ver = #{clientToolsVer}, update_time = sysdate() where session_id = #{sessionId} and del_flag = '0'

mapper.select: select sa.agent_id as agentId, ifnull(a.agent_name, concat('agent#', sa.agent_id)) as agentName, sa.role as role, ifnull(sa.tokens_used, 0) as tokens, ifnull(sa.prompt_tokens, 0) as promptTokens, ifnull(sa.completion_tokens, 0) as completionTokens, ifnull(sa.llm_call_count, 0) as callCount from ai_chat_session_agent sa left join ai_agent a on a.agent_id = sa.agent_id where sa.session_id = #{sessionId} and ifnull(sa.tokens_used, 0) > 0 order by (sa.role = 'supervisor') desc, sa.tokens_used desc
